Hold a valid standard driver’s license.  Pass written knowledge tests covering road signs, safety regulations, and driving rules.  Complete a practical driving test to demonstrate your ability to operate a truck safely.  Pass a Department of Transportation (DOT) physical examination to ensure you are medically fit to drive. Acquire additional endorsements if necessary, such as for hazardous materials, tank vehicles, or multiple trailers.  Meet vision and hearing requirements and be free from medical conditions that could impair driving ability.  Consider attending a truck driving school for specialized training and preparation for the CDL tests.     DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES  Drive the truck safely, adhering to all traffic laws and company safety policies.  Adhere to relevant regulations, including hours-of-service rules and vehicle weight limits.  Follow practices to minimize environmental impact, such as managing fuel consumption and reducing emissions.  Perform regular pre-trip and post-trip inspections to ensure the truck and specialized equipment are in good working  condition.  Complete preventive maintenance checks and basic repairs to vehicles.  Utilize GPS and other navigation tools to plan routes, stay on schedule, and manage efficient travel.  Load and unload cargo securely using Hiab crane, ensuring it is properly secured and protected during transit.  Review loading paperwork, inspect product condition, and obtain delivery confirmations.  Properly cover and secure items to prevent damage or loss.  Handle oversize and extendable steel products, including moving and configuring trailers and equipment as needed.  Plan and follow the most efficient routes to ensure timely deliveries while avoiding potential delays.  Maintain clear and effective communication with dispatchers and team members regarding delivery progress and any  issues.  Interact professionally with customers, addressing any issues or concerns and ensuring satisfaction.  Handle emergencies, such as breakdowns or accidents, following established procedures and ensuring safety.  Maintain accurate records of deliveries, driving hours, and vehicle maintenance.     SALARY  $75,000 to $80,000 per year     WORKING HOURS  Full-time position, 38 hours per week.     BENEFITS  Competitive salary based on experience along with 11.5% superannuation.  Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.  Paid time off and holidays.  Flexible work schedule. MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Medical Scientist





Job no: 944236

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide Metro Southern

Categories: Science, Engineering, Technical




 
Central Adelaide Local Health Network

Statewide - SA Pathology, Noarlunga Health Services

MeS2 $94,769 to $116,840 p.a. + Superannuation & Salary Sacrifice Benefits

SA, Noarlunga Centre 5168

Full Time, Temporary 12 Month Role 

About the role

Join our multidisciplinary metropolitan laboratory as a Medical Scientist, where you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality diagnostic services while supporting the day-to-day leadership of the laboratory. As a medical scientist, grade 2 you'll perform and supervise a broad range of routine diagnostic testing across haematology, chemistry and transfusion, applying your scientific expertise to analyse and report results that support outstanding patient care. You'll also participate in an after-hours roster and contribute to the smooth operation of general laboratory and clerical services.

This is an exciting opportunity to step into a leadership role. As the 2IC, you'll act as the Laboratory Manager during periods of leave, providing supervision, guidance and operational oversight to ensure the laboratory continues to run efficiently. Working alongside an experienced team, you'll also contribute to the introduction of new techniques and methodologies, making this an ideal opportunity for a motivated scientist who is ready to progress in their career.

About You

You are a motivated and detail-focused Medical Scientist who enjoys working as part of a collaborative team and is committed to delivering accurate, high-quality diagnostic services.

- Bachelor of Science or Medical Laboratory Science qualification (or equivalent)
- Experience performing laboratory testing using analytical equipment and laboratory systems
- Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills with a focus on quality
- Ability to work independently, show initiative and contribute positively to a multidisciplinary team

About us

Statewide Clinical Support Services (SCSS) is a unique public healthcare organisation that serves health consumers and provides specialist clinical services to the health system in South Australia. SCSS encompasses BreastScreen SA, SA Dental, SA Medical Imaging, SA Pathology, and SA Pharmacy. Come and work with us to improve the health and well-being of South Australians, across all age groups and at any time of their life or health need. 

What we offer

Salary Benefits: Enjoy flexible salary packaging options, including up to $9,010 each FBT year for living expenses (such as mortgage, rent, utilities and groceries) plus an additional $2,650 for meal and entertainment expenses.

Professional Development: Opportunity to apply for reimbursement of eligible professional development activities, and access to dedicated leave for ongoing learning.

Annual Leave: Enjoy paid recreation leave for essential rejuvenation, with leave loading applied.

Health and Fitness Benefits: Access to Fitness Passport, a discounted workplace health and fitness program for you and your family, plus an annual voluntary flu vaccination to support your wellbeing.

Employee Assistance Program: Confidential counselling and support services for you and your family via our Employee Assistance Program.

Diversity and inclusion:

Statewide supports and fosters a culture in which employees feel they belong and feel safe at work. The culture aims to encourage all people to use their talents and to be valued and rewarded for their contributions.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants are encouraged to apply. 

Application Information:

Please refer to the role description for essential educational-vocational qualifications that may be required.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and compliant Immunisation screening as indicated in the role description.

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Please note that unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies or third parties will not be accepted for this position.
